item.title: A Basic Just-In-Time Compiler (2015)
item.description:
📝 In a running process, the pages holding program code and loaded libraries will have their write bit cleared and execute bit set. So some different memory allocation calls will be made instead, with the details hidden behind an asmbuf struct. Instead of malloc(), the compiler allocates memory as an anonymous memory map (mmap()).
🔗 Read more: https://nullprogram.com/blog/2015/03/19/

item.title: Einstein Probe detects an X-ray flare from nearby star
item.description:
📝 December 31, 2025 report The GIST Einstein Probe detects an X-ray flare from nearby star by Tomasz Nowakowski, Phys. 1-0301 with a stellar flare from PM J23221-0301. More information: Guoying Zhao et al, Einstein Probe Discovery of an X-ray Flare from K-type Star PM J23221-0301, arXiv (2025).
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2025-12-einstein-probe-ray-flare-nearby.html
